resolvedFindings.title: Selecting a fixed-effort model omitted its known default and retained the previous model effort
resolvedFindings.trigger: Existing same-provider conversation default high; select a fixed-effort model whose configurable effort list is empty and native default is max. Both inherited mode and explicit collaboration mode preserved high. Real CLI fixture confirms omission and top-level null both retain high; explicit max resets it.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Shared modelDefaultEffort/modelSupportsEffort helpers admit only a unique model exact declared default when the adjustable list is explicitly empty. ModelPicker selects that exact default and displays it as fixed, preserving unsupported/stale values as actionable errors. Automation selector/save/reopen uses the same contract. Arbitrary strengths or an absent catalog do not gain authorization.

validatedFlows: Generated image read uses exact thread/turn/item/hash, bounded chunks, byte and offset checks, canonical base64, SHA256 and raster dimensions before object URL publication.

Image abort, identity switch, unmount, decode error and explicit collapse release references and reservations; search windows receive the same API and ownership inputs; exports retain media references and clearly require separate image download.

Active operation receipts are separate from bounded 500-row display history; archive-before-delete transaction and accepted/not-sent/unknown monotonicity are retained; retries use distinct identities; no acknowledgement UI for processed history.
Emergency recovery is explicitly confirmed, durable before dispatch, uses /api/recover while receipt reads use /api/rpc, and never automatically resends an unknown request.

Model display and selected catalog defaults match actual options; fixed native defaults are sent exactly without inventing an adjustable range; verified provider aliases and queued input semantics remain intact.

Root badge is a single inline sibling on the right of breadcrumb, sidebar refresh shares the sort row, mobile composer wraps controls without clipping, touch form controls retain 16px text without disabling pinch zoom.
